question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "avail."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Avail" means help or benefit. (मदद या लाभ)

 
 
• Example:* Our efforts **availed**__ us nothing*.
 
 
 
• This sentence conveys that while you're afloat, you can use this post office to access all of the nation's usual postal services.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

This post office lets you __**avail**__ all the regular postal services available in the country while being afloat. The seal used on everything posted from the Floating Post Office is unique – along with the date and address. It bears the design of a boatman rowing a Shikara on the Dal Lake. The special feature of this post office is that letters posted from here carry a special design which has the picturesque scenery of Dal Lake and Srinagar city. These pictures reach wherever these letters are posted to and ______ (4) ______ promote Kashmir as a tourist destination across the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Seen: **to become conscious of something, using your eyes; to use the power of sight. (देखना, नेत्रों द्वारा प्रत्‍यक्ष करना; दृष्टि-शक्ति का प्रयोग करना)
 
• **Account: **to think of someone or something in the stated way. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु के बारे में बताए गए तरीके से सोचना)
 
• **Mileage: **the distance that has been travelled, measured in miles. (तय की गई दूरी जो मीलों में नापी गई है, मील-दूरी; माइलेज)
